evidence.quoted_text: if commit not in repo.git('rev-list', tip).decode().splitlines():
evidence.reason: The fixing/superseding commit is only checked for reachability from tip, so an ancestor of target that predates the finding can be accepted. The history window and original anchor are target..tip, so such a commit cannot have fixed or superseded the finding; for fixed it only needs to touch the path, and superseded has no path check. Binding rev-list to target..tip closes the mismatch.
